bets.event: KT Rolster Challengers vs DN SOOPers Challengers — Game 2
bets.settlementBasis: DN SOOPers Challengers wins if its final kill total is no more than 5 below KT Rolster Challengers; loses only if KT.C finishes at least 6 kills ahead.
bets.result: DN SOOPers Challengers won Game 2; final kills KT.C 13-16 DNS.C, so DNS.C +5.5 kills won outright.
bets.seriesState: KT Rolster Challengers led the series 1-0 before Game 2; series tied 1-1 after DNS.C won Game 2.
bets.entryState: Post-draft, before the first meaningful Game 2 event; no intervening game action reported between recommendation and execution.

modelRecommendation.reasoning: KT.C retained the stronger team prior, but DNS.C passed the engage-to-damage conversion gate through Jarvan IV initiation, Ryze follow-up and Lucian-Milio sustained damage. KT.C had limited conventional frontline, improving DNS.C's kill-trading and margin-protection path.

execution.priceMoveClassification: favorable price-only move with no reported meaningful game event

review.resultAssessment: DNS.C won the map and final kill score 16-13, so the +5.5 handicap won outright.
review.processAssessment: The Game 2 draft correction was supported. Unlike Game 1, DNS.C had aligned initiation and follow-up damage through Jarvan IV, Ryze and Lucian-Milio, while KT.C lacked a durable conventional frontline. The result supports the engage-to-damage conversion gate directionally, but one win is not enough to validate the calibration by itself.

bets.notes: User confirmed DNS.C won Game 2 with final kills shown as KT.C 13-16 DNS.C. DNS.C +5.5 kills at 2.015 for 0.25u (125,000 VND), slip #1148310726, won. Payout 251,875 VND and net profit 126,875 VND (+0.25375u). This is confirmed LoL wager #16 since the dedicated chat began on 2026-07-29.
